title: Finite support and coproduct structure of bounded Hom diagonals
statement: Let C be a small site, J its topology, and R a commutative ring sheaf. For complexes P,N of R-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], suppose P^i is zero for i>b and N^j is zero for j<a. The product Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex] has projections to the internal Hom factors [def-pur-sheaf-hom] with its defining differential d_N f-(-1)^n f d_P. In each degree n these projections also exhibit that term as the coproduct over the finite interval [a-n,b]. Its inclusions have identity projection on their own factor and zero projection on all other factors, including the empty-interval case.

proof.text: Take the existing limit projections of the chosen Hom bifunctor, retaining their differential identity.
For p outside [a-n,b], either N^(p+n) or P^p is zero. The identity of the internal Hom factor is therefore zero, as follows directly from the internal Hom map formula.

Restrict the limit fan to the finite interval. A cone on the restricted factors extends by zero to all integers; uniqueness follows from the zero factors. Lift each coordinate identity and zeros along the original limit fan. The lift equations give the Kronecker projection identities. These maps form a finite bicone; the preadditive finite-bicone theorem isBilimitOfIsLimit makes its cocone colimiting.

theorem ringedSite_boundedFree_rhom_finiteSupport
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (P N : CochainComplex
      (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)) ℤ)
    (a b : ℤ) (hP : ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (P.X i))
    (hN : ∀ j : ℤ, j < a → IsZero (N.X j)) :
    ∃ π : ∀ (n p q : ℤ), p + n = q →
        ((homComplex (R := R) P N).X n ⟶
          SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (P.X p) (N.X q)),
      (∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (IsLimit (Fan.mk ((homComplex (R := R) P N).X n)
        (fun p : ℤ ↦ π n p (p + n) rfl)))) ∧
      (∀ (n m p q q' p' : ℤ) (_hnm : n + 1 = m)
        (hpq : p + m = q) (hq' : p + n = q') (hp' : p' + n = q),
        (homComplex (R := R) P N).d n m ≫ π m p q hpq =
          π n p q' hq' ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R)
              (𝟙 (P.X p)) (N.d q' q) -
            n.negOnePow • (π n p' q hp' ≫
              SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := R) (P.d p p') (𝟙 (N.X q)))) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ), ∃ ι : ∀ i : ↥(Finset.Icc (a - n) b),
          SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (P.X i) (N.X (i + n)) ⟶
            (homComplex (R := R) P N).X n,
        Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk ((homComplex (R := R) P N).X n) ι)) ∧
        ∀ (i : ↥(Finset.Icc (a - n) b)) (p : ℤ),
          ι i ≫ π n p (p + n) rfl =
            if h : (i : ℤ) = p then eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : ℤ ↦
              SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) (P.X k) (N.X (k + n))) h)
            else 0)
